clips.prompt: The young woman stands on the beach at golden hour, the wind in her long dark hair and coat; she notices the pale seashell lying on the wet sand to the left and starts to walk barefoot towards it, to the left. Natural continuous movement, steady camera, sound of wind and surf.

She walks on to the left over the wet sand, slows down at the pale seashell lying in front of her feet and bends down, reaching for it. Continuous movement, steady camera, sound of waves and footsteps.
She picks up the seashell from the sand, straightens up, looks at it and lifts it to her ear, closing her eyes, listening. Calm, continuous movement, steady camera, wind and surf.

Close-up: with the seashell at her ear and her eyes closed she listens, then opens her eyes, smiles, lowers the shell to her chest and looks out over the sea, the wind in her hair. Calm, gentle movement, the surf in the background.
